THE UTTAMA SEVA PADAKKAMA

IT is here by notified that His Excellency the President of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka and the Commander in Chiefof the Armed Forces has been graciously pleased to award the Uttama Seva Padakkama for the years Two Thousand Fourteen and Fifteenin term of regulation four of the Presidential Warrant instituting, constituting and creating the Uttama Seva Paddakkama published in theGovernment Gazette Extraordinary No. 156/5 of 01st September, 1981 to the persons named in the schedule hereto.
By His Excellancy’s Command,
KAPILA WAIDYARATHNE, p.cSecretary,Ministry of Defence.
Colombo16th May, 2018.
